description: SparkyFitness is a self-hosted fitness and nutrition tracker: log food, exercise, body measurements and water, set goals, and view reports and trends — a privacy-respecting alternative to MyFitnessPal.
name: SparkyFitness
seoDescription: Deploy SparkyFitness with Docker Compose on Dokploy — self-hosted nutrition, exercise and body-measurement tracking with PostgreSQL and generated secrets.
